def __init__(self,stock,build):
        self.fp_extra_ranges=[];self.lazy=None
        super().__init__(stock,build)
        provenance=next((r for r in stock.zeros if r['runtime_start']<=OWNER and OWNER+4<=r['runtime_end']),None)
        require(provenance is not None,'FP owner lacks exact original BSS-zero field provenance')
        page=OWNER&~4095
        if not any(lo<=page and page+4095<=hi for lo,hi,_ in self.uc.mem_regions()):
            self.uc.mem_map(page,4096,unicorn.UC_PROT_READ|unicorn.UC_PROT_WRITE)
        require(self.word(OWNER)==0,'FP owner already live; refusing reset')
        require(not any(lo<=TRAPSTACK+TRAPBYTES-1 and TRAPSTACK<=hi for lo,hi,_ in self.uc.mem_regions()),
                'Declared undefined stack overlaps previous storage')
        self.uc.mem_map(TRAPSTACK,TRAPBYTES,unicorn.UC_PROT_READ|unicorn.UC_PROT_WRITE)
        self.uc.mem_write(TRAPSTACK,b'\xa5'*TRAPBYTES)
        self.fp_extra_ranges=[(TRAPSTACK+32,TRAPSTACK+TRAPBYTES-32)]
        self.zones[page]=4096;self.zones[TRAPSTACK+32]=TRAPBYTES-64
        # Coprocessor access is a declared virtual startup input. This is
        # separate from FPEXC: only original restore/handler change its enable.
        self.uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_C1_C0_2,0xf00000)
        require(self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_C1_C0_2)==0xf00000,'Virtual CP10/11 input not actually set')
        self.lazy=LazyVFPState(self.uc,stock,lambda:self.running_task or self.word(0xf09090),
            lambda task,n:task in self.native_TCBs and bool(self.declared_storage(task,n)),TRAPSTACK+TRAPBYTES-32)
        self.virtual_fp_inputs=dict(CPACR='0xf00000',CPACR_is_explicit_virtual_startup_input=True,
            original_FP_boot20ED68_not_executed=True,original_FP_exit_listener_not_registered=True,
            owner_zero_field_provenance=provenance,undefined_stack=hex(TRAPSTACK),undefined_stack_bytes=TRAPBYTES,
            first_or_same_task_only=True,multi_task_FP_context_exchange_not_admitted=True)
        type(self).last_VM=self

def journal_zone_write(self,uc,access,address,size,value,data):
        pc=uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC)
        if not self.zone_active or pc not in [0x20ebe0,0x20ec78]:
            return super().journal_zone_write(uc,access,address,size,value,data)
        require(self.lazy is not None and self.lazy.active and
                uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_CPSR)&0x3f==0x1b and size==4,
                'Original handler push lacks exact active ARM undefined frame')
        row=self.lazy.active;top=self.lazy.stack_top
        if pc==0x20ebe0:
            opcode=0xe92d101f
            writes={top-24+4*n:int(row['before']['GP15'][r],16) for n,r in enumerate([0,1,2,3,4,12])}
        else:
            opcode=0xe92d4020
            writes={top-32:int(row['before']['GP15'][5],16),top-28:int(row['before']['PC'],16)+4}
        raw=struct.pack('<I',opcode)
        require(self.stock.read(pc,4)==raw and bytes(uc.mem_read(pc,4))==raw and
                address in writes and value==writes[address],
                'Original handler push opcode/address/register payload differs')
        zone=self.zone_rows[TRAPSTACK+32]
        require(int(zone['start'],16)<=address and address+size<=int(zone['start'],16)+zone['bytes'],
                'Original handler push crossed its declared undefined stack')
        zone['stores'].append(dict(PC=hex(pc),address=hex(address),size=size,value=value,
            before_hex=bytes(uc.mem_read(address,size)).hex(),phase=self.phase,
            running_task=hex(self.running_task),Thumb=False,
            original_instruction='push '+('{r0,r1,r2,r3,r4,ip}' if pc==0x20ebe0 else '{r5,lr}'),
            opcode_hex=raw.hex(),exact_original_architectural_frame_store=True))

def kernel_invoke(self,address,args=(),stack=None):
        require(self.kernel_active,'Original native kernel inventory absent')
        self.returned=False;self.idle_endpoint=False
        if stack is None:stack=self.word(0xf09090)
        for register,value in zip(REGS,args):self.uc.reg_write(register,value)
        self.uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_SP,stack);self.uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_LR,RETURN|1)
        current=address;quanta=0
        while quanta<24:
            try:self.uc.emu_start(current,RETURN+2,count=3000000,timeout=15000000)
            except unicorn.UcError as error:
                current=self.lazy.enter(error)
                print(json.dumps(dict(phase='original_lazy_VFP',fault=self.lazy.rows[-1]['before'],
                    instruction=self.lazy.rows[-1]['original_instruction'])),flush=True)
                continue
            if self.returned or self.idle_endpoint:break
            quanta+=1;pc=self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC);thumb=bool(self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_CPSR)&32)
            current=pc|1 if thumb else pc&~1
            print(json.dumps(dict(phase='resume_same_native_kernel_work',API=hex(address),PC=hex(pc),
                quantum=quanta,original_function_not_reentered=True)),flush=True)
        require((self.returned or self.idle_endpoint) and self.lazy.active is None,
                'Original kernel work failed to reach actual endpoint or complete its lazy-VFP handler')
        value=self.uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
        self.kernel_calls.append(dict(entry=hex(address),arguments=[hex(n) for n in args],
            original_return_endpoint_reached=self.returned,idle_sentinel_reached=self.idle_endpoint,
            current_after=hex(self.word(0xf09090)),result=hex(value)))
        return value

def journal_zone_write(self,uc,access,address,size,value,data):
        if not self.zone_active:return
        zone=next((row for start,row in self.zone_rows.items()if start<=address and address+size<=start+row['bytes']),None)
        require(zone is not None and size in [1,2,4],'Heap/settings write crossed a declared zone')
        pc=uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC);thumb=bool(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_CPSR)&32)
        opcode=self.stock.read(pc,4);instructions=list(self.store_disassemblers[thumb].disasm(opcode,pc,count=1))
        require(len(instructions)==1,'No original store instruction at heap writer')
        instruction=instructions[0]
        require(bytes(uc.mem_read(pc,instruction.size))==opcode[:instruction.size] and
                instruction.mnemonic.startswith(('str','stm','swp')),'Heap writer not an unchanged original store opcode')
        require(len(zone['stores'])<20000,'Heap/settings write journal exhausted')
        zone['stores'].append(dict(PC=hex(pc),address=hex(address),size=size,value=value,
            before_hex=bytes(uc.mem_read(address,size)).hex(),phase=self.phase,
            running_task=hex(self.running_task),Thumb=thumb,
            original_instruction=instruction.mnemonic+' '+instruction.op_str,opcode_hex=opcode[:instruction.size].hex()))

def verify_extra_zones(self):
        result=[]
        for start,row in self.zone_rows.items():
            expected=bytearray.fromhex(row['before_hex'])
            for store in row['stores']:
                offset=int(store['address'],16)-start;size=store['size']
                require(expected[offset:offset+size].hex()==store['before_hex'],'Zone journal missed an intervening net host mutation')
                expected[offset:offset+size]=int(store['value']).to_bytes(size,'little')
            actual=bytes(self.uc.mem_read(start,row['bytes']))
            require(actual==bytes(expected),'Whole heap/settings zone differs outside original CPU write history')
            result.append(dict(row,after_sha256=hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),whole_net_zone_matches_original_stores=True))
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(BUFFER-4096,4096))==b'\xa5'*4096 and
                bytes(self.uc.mem_read(BUFFER+8192,4096))==b'\xa5'*4096,'Heap extent crossed leading/trailing guard page')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(EXTENT,8))==struct.pack('<2I',BUFFER,8192) and
                bytes(self.uc.mem_read(EXTENT-32,32))==b'\xa5'*32 and
                bytes(self.uc.mem_read(EXTENT+8,32))==b'\xa5'*32,'Declared extent descriptor or guards changed')
        return result

def exact_raw(self,uc,address,caller,pointer,shape):
        task=self.running_task
        require(task==self.controller==self.word(0xf09090) and self.declared_storage(pointer,24),
                'Scoped heap/list raw semaphore actor/storage differs')
        require(self.word(pointer+16)==shape['tag_value'] and self.uc.mem_read(pointer+22,1)[0]==0,
                'Scoped heap/list/internal semaphore tag/class differs')
        if pointer not in self.native_semaphores:self.register_native_semaphore(pointer)
        require(not self.native_semaphores[pointer]['retained_condition_token'],'Raw heap lock is a retained token')
        row=dict(original_entry=hex(address),pointer=hex(pointer),native_caller=hex(caller),
            operation='lock'if address==0x3009a0 else'unlock',scope='exact_heap_list_or_current_internal',
            running_task=hex(task),entry_SP=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)),entry_LR=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)),
            before_words=[hex(self.word(pointer+4*n))for n in range(6)],native_body_returned=False,
            semaphore_fields_written_by_original_only=True,host_CPU_context_restore=False,reviewed_shape=shape)
        self.native_mutex_runs.append(row);self.scoped_raw_ops.append(row)
        self.task_mutex_ops[task].append(row);self.visits[address]+=1

def observe(self,uc,address,size,data):
        caller=uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1
        if self.kernel_active and address in [0x388be6,0x388bf8]:
            require(self.phase=='heap_ctor' and self.running_task==self.controller and
                    uc.reg_read(REGS[0])==0,'Original heap listener registration did not return success')
            self.listener_registrations.append(dict(native_return=hex(address),result=0,
                node=hex(0x3a7f150 if address==0x388be6 else 0x3a7f160)))
        if self.kernel_active and self.active_list and address==int(self.active_list['native_caller'],16):
            row=self.active_list;pointer=int(row['pointer'],16)
            require(row['native_initializer_observed'] and self.word(pointer)==0 and
                    bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer+4,24))==struct.pack('<6I',0,0,0,0,0x3cc660,0),
                    'Original list ctor whole head/backend result differs')
            row['original_constructor_returned']=True;self.list_constructors.append(row);self.active_list=None
        if self.kernel_active and address==0x3cc57c:
            pointer=uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            require(pointer in LISTS and self.active_list is None and self.running_task==self.controller,
                    'Original list ctor outside explicit instance/actor')
            require(self.declared_storage(pointer,28) and bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer,28))==b'\0'*28,
                    'Refusing to reset existing nonempty or initialized list')
            require((pointer==0x2d226b4 and caller==RETURN) or (pointer==0x148e680 and caller==0x2cbd8e),
                    'Original list ctor caller differs')
            self.active_list=dict(pointer=hex(pointer),backend=hex(pointer+4),native_caller=hex(caller),
                before_hex=bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer,28)).hex(),native_initializer_observed=False,
                original_constructor_returned=False,host_seeded_tag_or_head=False)
        if self.kernel_active and address==0x3008a0 and caller in [0x3cc58a,0x388bd0]:
            pointer=uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            if caller==0x3cc58a:
                require(self.active_list and pointer==int(self.active_list['backend'],16),'Original list native backend differs')
                self.active_list['native_initializer_observed']=True
            else:require(pointer==WORK+28 and self.phase=='heap_ctor','Original heap ctor native backend differs')
            storage=self.declared_storage(pointer,24)
            require(storage and self.active_backend is None,'Native heap/list init storage or nesting differs')
            row=dict(original_entry='0x3008a0',pointer=hex(pointer),native_caller=hex(caller),bytes=24,
                storage_boundary=storage,before_hex=bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer,24)).hex(),native_zero_writes=[],
                original_body_executed=False,host_seeded_backend_bytes=False)
            self.backend_initializations.append(row);self.active_backend=row;self.visits[address]+=1
            return
        if self.kernel_active and address in [0x3009a0,0x3008b0]:
            pointer=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]);shape=self.heap_raw_shapes.get((address,caller,pointer))
            if caller in [0x1c0618,0x1c0634]:
                require((address,caller)in [(0x3009a0,0x1c0618),(0x3008b0,0x1c0634)] and
                        pointer==self.running_task+56 and self.running_task in self.native_TCBs,
                        'Internal semaphore lacks exact actual current-TCB+56 provenance')
                require(pointer in self.internal_tags,'Internal semaphore has no pre-operation native tag snapshot')
                shape=dict(tag_value=self.internal_tags[pointer],pointer='actual_native_current_TCB+56',classification_byte=0,
                    tag_from_actual_preoperation_TCB=True)
            if shape:
                self.exact_raw(uc,address,caller,pointer,shape)
                return
        return super().observe(uc,address,size,data)

def verify_heap(self,cold=False):
        require(self.word(WORK+4)==BUFFER+4096 and self.word(WORK+0x18)==BUFFER and
                [self.word(WORK+o)for o in [0x50,0x54,0x58]]==[8192,4096,4096],
                'Original single-extent heap metadata differs')
        require(self.word(BUFFER)==27 and self.word(BUFFER+0x78)==BUFFER+0x7c and
                [self.word(BUFFER+4096),self.word(BUFFER+4100)]==[0,4096],
                'Original private prefix/free header differs')
        nodes=[];p=self.word(0x2d226b4)
        while p:
            require(p in [0x3a7f150,0x3a7f160] and p not in [r['pointer']for r in nodes],
                    'New heap exit-list listener chain differs')
            words=struct.unpack('<4I',self.uc.mem_read(p,16))
            nodes.append(dict(pointer=p,words=[hex(v)for v in words]));p=words[0]
        require([r['pointer']for r in nodes]==[0x3a7f150,0x3a7f160] and
                nodes[0]['words'][1:]==['0x1000000','0x388b57','0x0'] and
                nodes[1]['words'][1:]==['0x3000000','0x388b37','0x0'],'Two original heap listeners differ')
        ops=[r for r in self.backend_initializations if r['native_caller']=='0x388bd0']
        require(len(ops)==1 and ops[0]['original_body_executed'] and len(ops[0]['native_zero_writes'])==6 and
                self.word(WORK+44)==0x388d00,'Original heap native init/retag not complete')
        require([r['native_return'] for r in self.listener_registrations]==['0x388be6','0x388bf8'],
                'Missing both original successful listener registration returns')
        expected_buffer=bytearray(b'\0'*4096+b'\xcc'*4096)
        for offset,value in [(0,27),(0x78,BUFFER+0x7c),(4096,0),(4100,4096)]:
            struct.pack_into('<I',expected_buffer,offset,value)
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(BUFFER,8192))==bytes(expected_buffer),
                'Whole declared extent differs from native prefix/free-page recipe')
        if cold:
            expected_work=bytearray(96)
            for offset,value in [(4,BUFFER+4096),(0x18,BUFFER),(0x2c,0x388d00),
                                 (0x50,8192),(0x54,4096),(0x58,4096)]:
                struct.pack_into('<I',expected_work,offset,value)
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(WORK,96))==bytes(expected_work),
                    'Whole cold native heap workspace differs from exact one-extent recipe')
        require(not any(self.task_mutex_ops.values()) and not any(self.mutexes.values()),'Heap ctor returned with an ordinary lock')
        return dict(workspace96_hex=bytes(self.uc.mem_read(WORK,96)).hex(),listeners=nodes,
            native_initializer=ops[0],declared_extent=[hex(BUFFER),8192],original_prefix_reserve_bytes=4096,
            whole_extent_matches_original_recipe=True,whole_cold_workspace_recipe_checked=cold,
            listener_registration_returns=self.listener_registrations,native_real_device_allocator_verified=False)

def verify_native_endpoint(self,gui_condition,before,timed):
        require(self.returned and self.running_task==self.controller==self.word(0xf09090) and
                self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC)==RETURN and self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)==self.controller,
                'Native settings failed to return on the actual controller stack')
        require(len(self.settings_init_rows)==5,'Missing original five settings initializer bodies')
        for caller,(pointer,tag) in INIT.items():
            rows=[r for r in self.settings_init_rows if r['native_caller']==hex(caller)]
            require(len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['original_body_executed'] and len(rows[0]['native_zero_writes'])==6,
                    'Original settings initializer six stores incomplete')
            uses=[r for r in self.settings_raw_mutex_operations if r['pointer']==hex(pointer)]
            expected=struct.pack('<6I',*[int(v,16) for v in uses[-1]['after_words']]) if uses else struct.pack('<6I',0,0,0,0,tag,0)
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==expected and
                    self.word(pointer+8)==self.word(pointer+12)==0 and self.word(pointer+16)==tag and
                    self.word(pointer+20)==0,'Released native settings semaphore differs from its actual epilogue')
        expected={COND:(gui_condition,self.timer_task+32,self.timer_task,0,0x2cbf8c,0),
            gui_condition:(0,COND,self.timer_task,0,0x6048e8,0),COND+28:(0,0,0,0,0x2cbf8c,0)}
        for pointer,words in expected.items():
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==struct.pack('<6I',*words),
                    'Native two-condition retained Timer chain differs '+hex(pointer))
        require(self.word(COND+24)==self.native_condition_magic and
                set(self.dispatcher_condition_tokens)=={COND,gui_condition},'Native condition token inventory differs')
        ctors=[r for r in self.condition_constructor_runs if r['pointer']==hex(COND)]
        transfers=[r for r in self.native_condition_owner_transfers if r['condition']==hex(COND)]
        locks=[r for r in self.native_mutex_runs if r['pointer']==hex(COND) and r['scope']=='condition_constructor']
        require(len(ctors)==len(transfers)==len(locks)==1 and ctors[0]['native_constructor_returned'] and
                ctors[0]['original_mutex_lock_and_owner_store_executed'] and locks[0]['native_body_returned'] and
                locks[0]['native_owner']==hex(self.controller) and transfers[0]['owner_matches_timer'] and
                self.native_semaphores[COND]['retained_condition_token'],
                'Original second condition constructor/lock/Timer transfer incomplete')
        pending=[self.task_mutex_ops,self.task_waits,self.task_releases,self.task_lower_waits,self.task_notifications]
        require(not any(any(values.values()) for values in pending) and not self.task_constructors and
                self.active_backend is None and self.active_list is None and not any(self.mutexes.values()),
                'Native endpoint has an unresolved operation or ordinary lock')
        require(all(r['native_body_returned'] for r in self.scoped_raw_ops+self.settings_raw_mutex_operations),
                'Scoped native raw mutex operation failed to reach its original epilogue')
        require(len(self.list_constructors)==2 and {int(r['pointer'],16) for r in self.list_constructors}==set(LISTS) and
                all(r['original_constructor_returned'] for r in self.list_constructors),
                'Original exit/settings list constructors did not both return')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(0x148e680,28))==struct.pack('<7I',0,0,0,0,0,0x3cc660,0),
                'Original unused settings list head/backend differs')
        for pointer in [WORK+28,0x2d226b8]:
            uses=[r for r in self.scoped_raw_ops if r['pointer']==hex(pointer)]
            tag=0x388d00 if pointer==WORK+28 else 0x3cc660
            expected_raw=struct.pack('<6I',*[int(v,16) for v in uses[-1]['after_words']]) if uses else struct.pack('<6I',0,0,0,0,tag,0)
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==expected_raw and self.word(pointer+8)==self.word(pointer+12)==0 and
                    self.word(pointer+16)==tag and self.word(pointer+20)==0,
                    'Heap/list released backend differs from its observed native epilogue')
        after=self.native_task_inventory()
        require(after['all_tasks']==before['all_tasks'] and after['ready']==before['ready'],
                'Settings changed native ALL/ready membership')
        resident=[]
        for old,new in zip(before['tasks'],after['tasks']):
            task=int(old['TCB'],16);raw=bytearray.fromhex(old['raw108_hex'])
            require(task in self.native_TCBs and self.declared_storage(task,108),'Missing original native TCB lifetime')
            if task==self.timer_task:struct.pack_into('<I',raw,32,COND)
            for offset in [56,80]:
                pointer=task+offset
                uses=[r for r in self.scoped_raw_ops if r['pointer']==hex(pointer)]
                if uses:
                    require(task==self.controller and offset==56,'Unexpected internal semaphore use')
                    expected_raw=struct.pack('<6I',*[int(v,16) for v in uses[-1]['after_words']])
                    require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==expected_raw,'Whole internal semaphore differs from its native epilogue')
                    raw[offset:offset+8]=expected_raw[:8]
                require(self.word(pointer+8)==self.word(pointer+12)==0 and self.word(pointer+20)==0 and
                        self.word(pointer+16)==self.internal_tags[pointer],
                        'Native internal semaphore owner/waiter/depth/tag differs')
            require(bytes(raw)==bytes.fromhex(new['raw108_hex']),
                    'Whole native TCB changed outside exact retained head/internal stale links '+old['TCB'])
            require(self.word(task+32)==(COND if task==self.timer_task else 0),
                    'Final native task owned head differs')
            if task!=self.controller:
                require(old['saved_frame']==new['saved_frame'] and
                        old['saved_frame13_words']==new['saved_frame13_words'],
                        'Resident background original frame changed '+old['TCB'])
                resident.append(dict(TCB=old['TCB'],frame=new['saved_frame'],raw13=new['saved_frame13_words']))
        thread=int(timed['thread'],16)
        require(self.timed_thread_inventory(thread)==timed,'Original timed Thread node/context/virtual clock changed')
        owned=set()
        for task in self.native_TCBs:
            pointer=self.word(task+32);prev=task+32
            while pointer:
                require(pointer in self.native_semaphores and pointer not in owned and len(owned)<16 and
                        self.word(pointer+4)==prev and self.word(prev)==pointer and self.word(pointer+8)==task and
                        self.word(pointer+12)==0,'Native retained owned semaphore chain malformed')
                owned.add(pointer);prev=pointer;pointer=self.word(pointer)
        require(owned=={COND,gui_condition} and
                {p for p in self.native_semaphores if self.word(p+8)}==owned,
                'Registered native semaphore owners disagree with exact owned chains')
        require(not self.condition_bootstrap_tokens,'Inherited fake settings constructor lock was used')
        return dict(native_inventory=after,whole_TCB108_compared_with_exact_native_deltas=True,
            resident_four_frames=resident,timed_thread=timed,controller_old_WAIT_frame_consumed=True,
            actual_controller_SP=hex(self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)),condition_constructor=ctors[0],
            native_token_lock=locks[0],native_Timer_transfer=transfers[0],
            original_lists=self.list_constructors,inherited_settings_ret0_lock_used=False,
            real_allocator_release_or_physical_device_boot_verified=False)

def journal_mutable_write(self, uc, access, address, size, value, data):
        if not self.mutable_journal_active:
            return
        pc = uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC)
        thumb=bool(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_CPSR)&32)
        opcode=self.stock.read(pc,4)
        instructions=list(self.store_disassemblers[thumb].disasm(opcode,pc,count=1))
        require(self.mutable_bank_start <= address and address+size <= self.mutable_bank_start+self.mutable_bank_size
                and size in [1,2,4] and len(instructions)==1,
                'Mutable initialized-data write crosses declared scope')
        instruction=instructions[0]
        require(bytes(uc.mem_read(pc,instruction.size))==opcode[:instruction.size] and
                instruction.mnemonic.startswith(('str','stm','swp')),
                'Mutable-data writer opcode differs from original MAIN store instruction')
        require(len(self.mutable_cpu_stores) < 10000, 'Native settings write journal budget exhausted')
        before = bytes(uc.mem_read(address,size))
        self.mutable_cpu_stores.append(dict(PC=hex(pc),address=hex(address),size=size,
            before_hex=before.hex(),value=value, running_task=hex(self.running_task),
            Thumb=thumb,original_instruction=instruction.mnemonic+' '+instruction.op_str,
            original_opcode_hex=opcode[:instruction.size].hex()))

            require(bytes(raw)==bytes.fromhex(new['raw108_hex']),'Settings TCB changed outside retained-token owned head')

                    condition_constructor=ctors[0],native_token_lock=ops[0],original_transfer=transfers[0],

                    inherited_settings_lock_ret0_used=False,host_wrote_owner_or_ready_or_TCB=False,

def verify_singleton_inventory(self):
        data=self.native_task_inventory()
        dispatch,thread=sorted(t for t in self.native_TCBs if t not in [self.controller,self.idle,self.timer_task])
        require(data['all_tasks']==[hex(n)for n in [thread,dispatch,self.timer_task,self.controller,self.idle]],
            'Whole original ALL-task list order differs')
        require(data['ready']==[hex(n)for n in [self.controller,thread,dispatch,self.idle]],
            'Whole original ready list equal-priority FIFO order differs')
        global_mutex=0x34a59ac;wait=self.native_condition_waits[0]
        condition=int(wait['condition'],16);user_mutex=int(wait['mutex'],16);aux=condition+28
        expected_owned={self.controller:0,dispatch:global_mutex,thread:0,self.timer_task:condition,self.idle:0}
        expected_priorities={self.controller:16,dispatch:92,thread:92,self.timer_task:1,self.idle:240}
        for t,head in expected_owned.items():
            require(self.declared_storage(t,108),'Native TCB backing no longer live and declared')
            require(self.word(t+32)==head,'Native task owned-mutex head differs '+hex(t))
            require(self.uc.mem_read(t+22,1)[0]==(2 if t==self.timer_task else 1) and
                self.uc.mem_read(t+16,1)[0]==self.uc.mem_read(t+17,1)[0]==expected_priorities[t],
                'Native task state/base/effective priority differs')
            require(self.word(t+24)==((5 if t in [dispatch,thread] else 0)<<28)|0x0ed1a247,
                'Native TCB flags/header magic differs')
            for offset in [56,80]:
                require(self.word(t+offset+8)==self.word(t+offset+12)==0 and
                    int.from_bytes(self.uc.mem_read(t+offset+20,2),'little')==0,
                    'Unexpected owned or queued native task internal semaphore')
        for ptr,owner in [(global_mutex,dispatch),(condition,self.timer_task)]:
            require(self.word(ptr)==0 and self.word(ptr+4)==owner+32 and self.word(ptr+8)==owner and self.word(ptr+12)==0 and
                int.from_bytes(self.uc.mem_read(ptr+20,2),'little')==0,'Resident owned mutex fields/list links differ '+hex(ptr))
        require(self.word(user_mutex+8)==0 and self.word(aux+8)==0,'Released user/auxiliary mutex still owned')
        require({p:n for p,n in self.mutexes.items()if n}=={global_mutex:1},'Counter inventory disagrees with native resident global ownership')
        require(self.dispatcher_condition_tokens[condition]['explicit_retained_bootstrap_token']==1 and
            self.dispatcher_condition_tokens[condition]['native_owner']==hex(self.timer_task),'Explicit retained native condition token differs')
        require(not any(self.task_waits.values()) and not any(self.task_releases.values()) and not any(self.task_lower_waits.values()),
            'Returned controller leaves incomplete condition/release/lower wait')
        require(len(self.task_mutex_ops[dispatch])==len(self.task_mutex_ops[thread])==1 and
            self.task_mutex_ops[dispatch][0]['operation']=='lock' and self.task_mutex_ops[thread][0]['operation']=='unlock',
            'Resident worker continuation inventory differs')
        expected_frames=[(dispatch,0x300d98,0x8804f1c,{2:self.controller,3:global_mutex,4:dispatch,5:0x8804f50,11:0x8804f50,12:0x3009f1}),
            (thread,0x358ebc,0x8809254,{2:thread,11:0x8809288,12:0x300911})]
        for t,pc,frame,fields in expected_frames:
            require(self.word(t+12)==frame and self.word(frame+4)==pc and
                self.uc.mem_read(t+23,1)[0]==0 and self.word(frame)&31==31,
                'Resident native worker context frame/PC/system mode differs '+hex(t))
            words=struct.unpack('<13I',self.uc.mem_read(frame,52))
            require(words[0]&0xbf==0xbf and all(words[n]==value for n,value in fields.items()) and
                self.declared_storage(frame,52),'Resident frame Thumb/IRQ mask/registers/live backing differs')
        require(self.word(0x8804f50+4)==0,'Transferred dispatcher mutex waiter marker was not cleared by original fullrelease')
        data.update(native_owned_mutex_heads={hex(t):hex(v)for t,v in expected_owned.items()},
            semaphores={hex(p):bytes(self.uc.mem_read(p,24)).hex()for p in [global_mutex,condition,user_mutex,aux]},
            pending_mutex_operations={hex(t):rows for t,rows in self.task_mutex_ops.items()if rows},
            resident_dispatcher_marker_cleared=True,whole_native_ready_ALL_and_owned_list_checked=True,
            tasks_and_condition_token_remain_resident=True,task_quiescence_or_safe_unload_verified=False)
        return data

            values=list(struct.unpack('<'+str(len(names))+'I',self.uc.mem_read(self.symbol(table),4*len(names))))

        for address,raw in self.code_images:

def observe(self, uc, address, size, data):
        caller = uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1
        if address == 0x358bf8:
            self.record_descriptor(uc,caller)
        if not self.kernel_active:
            return super().observe(uc,address,size,data)
        if self.running_task is None:
            self.running_task = self.word(0xf09090)
        if self.pending_restore is not None and address == (int(self.pending_restore['saved_PC'],16)&~1):
            row = self.pending_restore
            row['original_task_resume_destination_reached'] = True
            self.running_task = int(row['current'],16)
            self.dispatch_destinations.append(dict(address=hex(address),task=hex(self.running_task)))
            self.pending_restore = None
        task = self.running_task
        require(task in self.native_TCBs,'Running CPU task lacks observed original TCB construction')
        if address == CODE:
            require(task == self.idle and self.word(0xf09090) == self.idle,'Idle sentinel task mismatch')
            self.idle_endpoint = True
            uc.emu_stop()
            return
        if address == POST:
            target = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            require(target in self.native_TCBs,'Original post target lacks native TCB construction')
            self.kernel_events.append(dict(entry=hex(address),running_task=hex(task),
                ready_head=hex(self.word(0xf09090)),arguments=[hex(uc.reg_read(r))for r in REGS],
                original_post_entry_reached=True,host_fabricated_wake=False))
            self.visits[address] += 1
            return
        if address == RESTORE:
            target = self.word(0xf09090)
            require(target in self.native_TCBs,'Restore target lacks observed native TCB construction')
            frame = self.word(target+12)
            row = dict(current=hex(target),previous_running_task=hex(task),saved_context=hex(frame),
                saved_PC=hex(self.word(frame+4)),context_format=bytes(uc.mem_read(target+23,1))[0],
                original_restore_entry_reached=True,original_task_resume_destination_reached=False,
                python_CPU_context_restore=False)
            self.kernel_restores.append(row)
            self.pending_restore = row
            for wait in self.task_waits[task]:
                wait['context_restore_boundary_reached'] = True
            self.visits[address] += 1
            return

        # Native function return addresses are checked in the task that entered
        # the function, including when another task changed F09090 meanwhile.
        for pending, collection, pointer_key in [
                (self.task_releases[task],self.native_full_releases,'pointer'),
                (self.task_lower_waits[task],self.native_lower_wait_operations,'condition')]:
            if pending and address == int(pending[-1]['native_caller'],16):
                row = pending.pop()
                ptr = int(row[pointer_key],16)
                owner,depth = self.sync_counter_from_native(ptr)
                row.update(original_body_returned=True,original_return=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]),
                    native_owner_after=hex(owner),native_recursion_after=depth,
                    ready_head_after=hex(self.word(0xf09090)),running_task_after=hex(task),
                    guest_fields_written_by_original_only=True)
        waits = self.task_waits[task]
        if waits and waits[-1].get('original_return_branch_reached') and address == int(waits[-1]['native_caller'],16):
            row = waits.pop()
            ptr = int(row['mutex'],16)
            owner,depth = self.sync_counter_from_native(ptr)
            require(owner == task and self.mutexes[ptr] == 1,'Native condition returned without actual-task mutex reacquisition')
            row.update(original_wait_returned=True,original_return=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]),
                native_owner_after=hex(owner),native_reacquisition_verified=True,
                real_kernel_wait_verified=True,physical_kernel_or_IRQ_timing_verified=False)

        self.active_condition = self.task_constructors.get(task)
        if address == 0x3ec5c6:
            cond,mutex,deadline,kind = [uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS]
            require(cond in self.native_semaphores and mutex in self.native_semaphores,
                'Condition wait uses unobserved native semaphore')
            row = dict(original_entry=hex(address),native_caller=hex(caller),condition=hex(cond),
                mutex=hex(mutex),native_argument=hex(deadline),native_kind=kind,running_task=hex(task),
                semaphore_owner_before=hex(self.word(mutex+8)),native_owner_gate_passed=False,
                original_wait_returned=False,real_kernel_wait_verified=False)
            self.native_condition_waits.append(row)
            waits.append(row)
        if address == 0x3ec5ea and waits:
            row = waits[-1]
            require(self.word(int(row['mutex'],16)+8) == task == uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_R4),
                'Original condition owner gate running task mismatch')
            row['native_owner_gate_passed'] = True
        if address == 0x3ec6a0 and waits:
            require(uc.reg_read(REGS[3]) == (int(waits[-1]['native_caller'],16)|1),
                'Condition return epilogue did not restore saved LR')
            waits[-1]['original_return_branch_reached'] = True
        if address == 0x3ec498:
            row=dict(original_entry=hex(address),native_caller=hex(caller),
                condition=hex(uc.reg_read(REGS[0])),running_task=hex(task),host_fabricated_notification=False,
                original_broadcast_returned=False)
            self.condition_notifications.append(row)
            self.task_notifications[task].append(row)
        if address == 0x3ec4f8 and self.task_notifications[task]:
            row=self.task_notifications[task][-1]
            require(uc.reg_read(REGS[3])==(int(row['native_caller'],16)|1),'Broadcast native saved LR differs')
            row['original_return_branch_reached']=True
        if self.task_notifications[task] and self.task_notifications[task][-1].get('original_return_branch_reached') and address==int(self.task_notifications[task][-1]['native_caller'],16):
            self.task_notifications[task].pop()['original_broadcast_returned']=True

        if address in [0x3009a0,0x3008b0]:
            ptr = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            cpp = caller == (0x310408 if address == 0x3009a0 else 0x310414)
            recursive_cpp = caller == (0x46c2ae if address == 0x3009a0 else 0x46c2be)
            ctor = address == 0x3009a0 and caller == 0x3ec572 and self.active_condition is not None
            aux_wait = address == 0x3009a0 and caller == 0x3ec61c and waits and ptr == int(waits[-1]['condition'],16)+28
            reacquire = address == 0x3009a0 and caller == 0x3ec692 and waits and ptr == int(waits[-1]['mutex'],16)
            notify_aux = caller == (0x3ec4be if address == 0x3009a0 else 0x3ec4ee)
            require(cpp or recursive_cpp or ctor or aux_wait or reacquire or notify_aux,
                'Native mutex caller outside explicit per-task GUI scope: '+hex(caller))
            require(self.declared_storage(ptr,24),'Native semaphore outside declared guarded storage')
            if cpp:
                require(self.word(ptr-4)==0xc1b5dc and self.word(ptr+16)==0x31041c,'Native C++ mutex vtable/tag mismatch')
            if recursive_cpp:
                require(self.word(ptr-28)==0xc1b5c4 and self.word(ptr+16)==0x46c2c8,'Native recursive C++ mutex vtable/tag mismatch')
            if notify_aux:
                require(self.task_notifications[task] and ptr==int(self.task_notifications[task][-1]['condition'],16)+28,
                    'Broadcast auxiliary mutex does not belong to active native condition')
            if ctor:
                require(ptr == int(self.active_condition['pointer'],16) and
                    self.word(ptr+24)==self.native_condition_magic and bytes(uc.mem_read(ptr,24))==b'\0'*24 and
                    bytes(uc.mem_read(ptr+28,24))==b'\0'*24 and ptr not in self.dispatcher_condition_tokens,
                    'Original condition constructor token storage differs')
            if ptr not in self.native_semaphores:
                self.register_native_semaphore(ptr)
            if ctor:
                self.native_semaphores[ptr]['retained_condition_token'] = True
            scope = ('Cpp_mutex' if cpp else 'recursive_Cpp_mutex') if (cpp or recursive_cpp) else ('condition_constructor' if ctor else
                ('condition_reacquisition' if reacquire else 'condition_auxiliary'))
            row = dict(original_entry=hex(address),pointer=hex(ptr),native_caller=hex(caller),
                operation='lock' if address==0x3009a0 else 'unlock',scope=scope,running_task=hex(task),
                entry_SP=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)),entry_LR=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)),
                before_words=[hex(self.word(ptr+4*n))for n in range(6)],native_body_returned=False,
                semaphore_fields_written_by_original_only=True,host_CPU_context_restore=False)
            self.native_mutex_runs.append(row)
            self.task_mutex_ops[task].append(row)
            if reacquire:
                waits[-1]['original_reacquire_entry_reached'] = True
            self.visits[address] += 1
            return
        if address in [0x300a0a,0x30092a]:
            pending = self.task_mutex_ops[task]
            require(pending,'Mutex epilogue has no pending operation for actual running task')
            row = pending.pop()
            require(address == (0x300a0a if row['operation']=='lock' else 0x30092a) and
                uc.reg_read(REGS[3])==(int(row['native_caller'],16)|1),'Native mutex task/caller epilogue mismatch')
            ptr = int(row['pointer'],16)
            owner,depth = self.sync_counter_from_native(ptr)
            native_result=uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            if row['operation']=='lock' and native_result==0:
                require(owner==task,'Native lock returned0 without ownership by originating task')
            if row['scope'] == 'condition_constructor':
                require(owner==task and depth==0 and self.active_condition is not None,'Retained condition token native owner mismatch')
                self.active_condition.update(bootstrap_token_retained=True,
                    original_mutex_lock_and_owner_store_executed=True,native_owner=hex(owner))
                self.dispatcher_condition_tokens[ptr]=dict(pointer=hex(ptr),native_caller='0x3ec572',
                    explicit_retained_bootstrap_token=1,original_native_owner_store=True,native_owner=hex(owner),
                    ordinary_mutex_counter_not_incremented_or_swept=True,safe_lifetime_verified=False)
            row.update(native_body_returned=True,original_return_branch_reached=True,
                after_words=[hex(self.word(ptr+4*n))for n in range(6)],native_owner=hex(owner),
                original_return=native_result,native_lock_acquired_by_originating_task=(owner==task if row['operation']=='lock' else None),
                native_recursion_count=depth,thread_owned_list_head=hex(self.word(task+32)),
                ready_head_at_epilogue=hex(self.word(0xf09090)))
        if address == 0x300bb8:
            ptr = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            require(ptr in self.native_semaphores and self.word(ptr+8)==task,
                'Original full release lacks current native ownership')
            require(caller in [0x3ec642,0x3ec648,0x30090a],
                'Original full release caller outside observed GUI scope: '+hex(caller))
            row = dict(original_entry=hex(address),pointer=hex(ptr),native_caller=hex(caller),
                running_task=hex(task),native_owner_before=hex(self.word(ptr+8)),
                native_waiter_head_before=hex(self.word(ptr+12)),original_body_returned=False,
                host_wrote_owner_or_links=False)
            self.native_full_releases.append(row)
            self.task_releases[task].append(row)

            self.put(args[3],statement)

        elif name=='bind64':
            row=self.statements[args[0]]
            require(not row['closed'] and 1<=args[1]<=row['sql'].count('?'),'Bad SQLite parameter index')
            raw=args[2] | args[3]<<32
            signed=raw if raw<1<<63 else raw-(1<<64)
            row['bound'][args[1]]=signed
            self.sql_events.append({'operation':'bind64_engine_fixture','index':args[1],'value':signed})
        elif name=='step':
            row=self.statements[args[0]];require(not row['closed'],'Step on closed statement')
            if row['cursor'] is None:

                row['cursor']=self.db.execute(row['sql'],tuple(row['bound'][n] for n in range(1,len(row['bound'])+1)))

        else:
            require(args[0]==self.menu_pointer() and args[3]==0,'Unexpected normal widget factory ABI')

def observe(self, uc, address, size, unused):
        if address in [0x2d3166, 0xfea50, 0x2d32de]:
            if address == 0x2d3166:
                self.native_bound_calls.append([uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS])
            elif address == 0xfea50:
                self.native_activation_calls.append([uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS[:2]])
            # Bypass only the older harness's high-level fixtures; execute
            # the original instruction at this address, including region I/O.
            return VoiceMetadata.observe(self, uc, address, size, unused)
        if address in [FILE_OPEN, FILE_READ, FILE_CLOSE, 0x38853c,
                       0x3887a6, 0x300934, 0x3008a0]:
            self.visits[address] += 1
            args = [uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS]
            if address == FILE_OPEN:
                drive, obj = args[:2]
                require(drive == DRIVES, 'Unexpected virtual driver ABI')
                name = self.wide(self.handles[self.word(obj + 4)]['pointer'])
                row = next((r for r in self.inventory if name == '/Garmin/Voice/' + r['name']), None)
                require(row is not None, 'Virtual file path absent from immutable inventory')
                error = self.open_errors.pop(0) if self.open_errors else 0
                self.backend_events.append({'operation': 'driver_open_fixture', 'path': name,
                    'mode': struct.unpack('<H', uc.mem_read(obj + 2, 2))[0], 'result': error})
                if error:
                    self.ret(error)
                    return
                child = CHILDREN + len(self.backend_children) * 128
                require(child + 128 <= 0x08028000, 'Virtual driver child inventory exhausted')
                self.backend_children[child] = {'data': row['data'], 'closed': False}
                uc.mem_write(child, b'\x01\x00\x01\x00')
                self.put(child + 0x20, len(row['data']))
                self.put(child + 0x2c, DRIVES)
                self.put(obj + 0xc, child)
                self.ret()
                return
            if address == FILE_READ:
                child, destination, low, high = args
                count = self.word(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP))
                row = self.backend_children[child]
                require(not row['closed'] and high == 0 and 0 < count <= 4096,
                        'Unexpected virtual read or closed file')
                require(0x08000000 <= destination and destination + count <= 0x08600000,
                        'Virtual read destination outside fixture RAM')
                data = row['data'][low:low + count]
                uc.mem_write(destination, data)
                self.backend_events.append({'operation': 'driver_read_fixture',
                    'offset': low, 'requested': count, 'returned': len(data)})
                self.ret(len(data))
                return
            if address == FILE_CLOSE:
                row = self.backend_children[args[0]]
                require(not row['closed'], 'Virtual driver double close')
                row['closed'] = True
                self.backend_events.append({'operation': 'driver_close_fixture'})
                self.ret()
                return
            if address == 0x38853c:
                length, kind, output = args[:3]
                require(0 < length <= 4096 and kind in [0, 1], 'Unexpected heap allocation')
                handle = 0xd0000000 + len(self.handles) + 1
                pointer = self.next_heap
                self.next_heap += (length + 127) & ~63
                require(self.next_heap < 0x080f0000, 'Heap exhausted')
                uc.mem_write(pointer - 32, b'\xa5' * (length + 64))
                self.handles[handle] = {'pointer': pointer, 'length': length,
                                       'locks': 0, 'freed': False}
                self.allocations.append({'length': length, 'kind': kind})
                if output:
                    self.put(output, handle)
                self.ret(handle)
                return
            if address == 0x3887a6:
                self.ret(self.handles[args[0]]['length'])
                return
            if address == 0x300934:
                self.mutexes[args[0]] += 1
                self.ret(1)
                return
            self.ret()
            return
        return super().observe(uc, address, size, unused)

            'loader_result_captured_before_native_compare':self.loader_return,

def observe(self, uc, address, size, _):
        self.visits[address] += 1
        if address == RETURN:
            self.returned = True; uc.emu_stop(); return
        name = self.hooks.get(address)
        if name is None: return
        args = [uc.reg_read(reg) for reg in REGS]
        value = 0
        if name == 'region_read':
            region, offset, count, destination = args
            require(region == REGION and 0 < count <= 4096,
                    'Unexpected lower region-read arguments')
            available = max(0, min(count, len(self.data)-offset))
            require(0x08000000 <= destination < 0x08600000,
                    'Region read outside fixture RAM')
            if available: uc.mem_write(destination, self.data[offset:offset+available])
            self.reads.append({'offset': offset, 'requested': count, 'returned': available})
            value = available
        elif name == 'mutex_lock': self.mutexes[args[0]] += 1
        elif name == 'mutex_unlock':
            require(self.mutexes[args[0]] > 0, 'Unbalanced synthetic mutex')
            self.mutexes[args[0]] -= 1
        elif name == 'irq_restore': require(args[0] == 0, 'Unexpected IRQ fixture token')
        elif name == 'allocate_handle':
            length,kind,out=args[:3]
            require(0 < length < 4096 and kind in (0,1),'Unexpected handle allocation')
            handle=0xd0000000+len(self.handles)+1
            pointer=self.next_heap;self.next_heap+=(length+127)&~63
            require(self.next_heap<0x080f0000,'Fixture heap exhausted')
            self.uc.mem_write(pointer-32,b'\xa5'*(length+64))
            self.handles[handle]={'pointer':pointer,'length':length,'locks':0,'freed':False}
            self.put(out,handle);self.allocations.append({'length':length,'kind':kind})
        elif name in ('lock_handle','unlock_handle'):
            entry=self.handles[args[0]]
            require(not entry['freed'],'Use of freed fixture handle')
            if name=='lock_handle':entry['locks']+=1;value=entry['pointer']
            else:
                require(entry['locks']>0,'Unbalanced handle unlock');entry['locks']-=1
        elif name=='release_handle':
            entry=self.handles[self.word(args[0])]
            require(not entry['freed'] and entry['locks']==0,'Unsafe fixture handle release')
            entry['freed']=True;self.put(args[0],0)
        elif name=='cache_sync':
            self.uc.ctl_remove_cache(IMAGE,DESCRIPTOR)
        uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_R0, value)
        uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_PC, uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR))

        require(not any(self.mutexes.values()), 'Mutex left held at native return')
